name: Sasaki Ichigo
source:
A troublemaker brimming with curiosity.
It isn’t that she intentionally brings on disaster; her sheltered life means that she knows nothing, and so she naturally invites misunderstandings and trouble.
She started life at the boarding school with her twin sister, and overall is satisfied with all the novelty at the academy.
She is cheery, so she speaks openly with the people around her, and gets along well with her classmates.
She is especially close with [url=/c16862]Mayuri Kohsaka[/url].
Her interests are the latest fashions and collecting frog memorabilia.

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/]Jast USA[/url]]
